about: Wristkeeper's watch catalog. One entry per model family, each with the page its specs were read from. A spec appears only where that page states it for every model code listed; a missing spec means unknown, never zero. Sizes in mm, water resistance in metres. The app bundles this exact file and refreshes it from theusefulmedia.com/wristkeeper/catalog.json at most once a day.
